chatterbox-turbo.note: Conservative expressive audition profile. Native chuckle/laugh/sigh cues are supported; arbitrary acting instructions and CFG/exaggeration are not.

chatterbox-nano.note: Match Turbo's supported sampling settings for comparison. This is a candidate profile, not a measured optimum.

qwen3-custom.speaker: Ryan
qwen3-custom.note: Use the English-native Ryan speaker and beat-level instructions. Sampling settings favor coherent delivery while retaining variation.

kokoro.note: Expressive preset at a slightly relaxed rate. No unsupported emotion, pitch, cloning, or nonverbal-event controls are claimed.
